evidence.classes: PCCreationInfo Class, then PcData Class rows without a creation row (Fighter)
evidence.damage: Damage EffectValueList, candidate reading: flat min/max, weapon ratio min/max (1/10000)

evidence.projectile: Skill.dat SkillEffectTimeDataList ProjectileId of the time row a Damage row belongs to
evidence.projectile_speeds: SkillProjectile.dat Speed (newest research/local export naming the table)
evidence.charges: SkillCharge.dat ChargeMinTime, bMovableInCharge, SkillChargeDataList {ChargeTime, ChargeSkillId}; a cast row has charge = its Skill.dat ChargeId; the step skills are added as cast rows
